_purpose: Pre-holdout architecture freeze manifest, V4 -- supersedes V3 for holdout-gating purposes. V1, V2, V3 all preserved unmodified, not deleted, for chronology.

lineage.reason: initial pre-holdout freeze after closing the last two disclosed extraction limitations (scope, historical values)
resolved B3-002/B2-006 predicate semantics + third scope case + CandidateClaim architecture documentation -- no code changes, dataset/docs only
taxonomy #19 -- _UNAVAILABLE_MARKERS bare 'maintenance' collided with ordinary procurement vocabulary, found via a NEW development case (B4-002)

taxonomy #20 -- the same subsystem's SHOULD/MUST-NOT red-team matrix (built specifically because #19 flagged it unreliable) found 2 real misses ('offline', 'could not be accessed') in the opposite direction from #19 -- a false-negative, not a false-positive

why_a_v4_freeze_was_needed: Taxonomy #20: _UNAVAILABLE_MARKERS missed 'database offline' and 'records could not be accessed' entirely -- both plausible real system-status phrasings not yet used by any document in the corpus, found by directly red-teaming the subsystem taxonomy #19 had already flagged as under-tested. A worse failure class than #19 (silently treats unavailable evidence as available, producing a confident wrong answer, rather than #19's overly-cautious false INCOMPLETE). Fixed by adding both markers, verified against all 5 MUST-NOT cases and the full corpus for collisions before adding.
infrastructure_changes_since_v3_not_requ: dataset_registry.py + LNES59_DATASET_MANIFEST.json (commit 00eb5ca): manifest-driven, hash-verified file loading replacing hardcoded per-loader tuples. Pure infrastructure, no extraction/gate/schema semantics touched.

case_view.py + test_leakage.py (commit 58cd353): RUNNER_CASE/EVALUATOR_CASE information boundary + automated leakage test, built now rather than deferred to holdout sealing. No architecture semantics touched -- confirms an existing property (arm_x2.build_prompt already didn't leak gold fields) rather than changing behavior.

explicitly_not_frozen.cases*.json / documents*.json: dataset content -- Phase 5 continues adding tranches under these same frozen rules
explicitly_not_frozen.dataset_registry.py, LNES59_DATASET_MANI: infrastructure, not architecture -- updated every time a new batch is added, by design
explicitly_not_frozen.test_*.py: test files grow with the dataset and with each red-team pass

gate._version_note: UNCHANGED since V1 -- taxonomy #19 and #20 were both extraction-layer, not gate-layer.

extraction._version_note: 1.3 = V3 freeze (taxonomy #19). 1.4 = this freeze -- taxonomy #20 (_UNAVAILABLE_MARKERS extended with 'offline'/'could not be accessed').

regression_suite_state_at_freeze._total: 247/247, all green at the frozen commit -- labeled DETERMINISTIC REGRESSION SUITE, explicitly NOT benchmark/blind accuracy (see LNES59_FINAL_REPORT.md's required framing)

dataset_state_at_freeze._note: Unchanged since V3 -- this freeze's changes were architecture (taxonomy #20) and infrastructure (registry, case_view), not new dataset tranches. Phase 5 dataset scaling continues under V4.

known_remaining_limitations_at_freeze: Sparse (2-word) NO_MATCH value tokens whose negation marker does not survive the word-length filter remain vulnerable to a vague-hedge false match (taxonomy #17) -- disclosed, deliberately not fixed by growing values_match(); mitigation is dataset-side (prefer NOT_X over NO_X phrasing).
PREDICATE_ALIAS category remains unused in the corpus.
No B0-B4 baseline or full X0-X1 sweep has been run -- X2 remains the only arm with real empirical data.

The unavailability/no-record marker lists, even after taxonomy #19-20's fixes, remain a disclosed, bounded adapter -- not general NLP. Future tranches should keep red-teaming both directions (SHOULD-detect misses and MUST-NOT-trigger false positives) as new document vocabulary is introduced, the same discipline that found both #19 and #20.
